description:
Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve. 

Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals.

About the Role:

Hims & Hers is looking for an outstanding Manager, Legal Programs, Privacy & AI (EU/UK) to join our growing Legal team. We’re looking for a curious, proactive privacy and AI governance professional to play a central role in running and scaling the systems our UK and European businesses use to protect personal data and govern AI.

Focusing primarily on our privacy program, with a share of your time on our AI governance program, you will report to our Senior Counsel, Privacy & AI (EU/UK) and partner closely with our EU/UK privacy team, our Data Protection Officer, our global Privacy & AI Legal team, and teams across the business to maintain our privacy commitments, build out responsible AI practices, and help solve complex legal and compliance problems at the intersection of healthcare, technology, and consumer products. This is a remote role open to candidates based in the UK or EU.

You Will:

Privacy Program

  • Help lead the day-to-day operations of our EU/UK privacy program, developing the processes, workflows, and documentation that support compliance with the UK GDPR, EU GDPR, and related laws across the region.

  • Manage the data subject rights process for the region, coordinating access, deletion, and other requests with Patient Support, Engineering, and Legal.

  • Administer our consent management platform and coordinate its rollout across brands and markets with Engineering, Marketing, and Product teams.

  • Help build and maintain core privacy records, including data maps, records of processing activities, DPIA and legitimate interests assessment registers, and records of international data transfers.

  • Coordinate privacy reviews within our vendor risk management process, including questionnaire triage, DPA tracking, and escalation to counsel.

  • Support privacy incident response with intake, tracking, documentation, and deadline management.

  • Maintain audit-ready documentation for rights requests, incidents, training, and other accountability processes.

  • Coordinate privacy training and awareness activities for teams in the region.

AI Governance Program

  • Help maintain the UK and EU portion of our inventory of AI systems and use cases, including records that support EU AI Act classification.

  • Coordinate intake of new AI use cases from the region into our global AI governance process.

  • Support AI incident response for the region, in coordination with our global AI incident response process.

Across Both Programs

  • Own implementation responsibility for strategic legal initiatives that require close cross-functional work with Product, Engineering, and Marketing

  • Track program initiatives, owners, and milestones, and prepare metrics and status reporting for regional and global leadership.

  • Keep program procedures and playbooks current in the team’s knowledge base.

  • Coordinate with Legal and Public Policy teams to monitor evolving UK and EU privacy and AI legislation and translate new requirements into practical program updates

You Have:

  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent work experience - Required

  • 6+ years of experience in privacy operations or legal program management, with a focus on UK or EU data protection - Required

  • Working knowledge of the UK GDPR and EU GDPR, with hands-on experience running data subject request processes and maintaining records of processing activities or DPIA registers

  • Experience administering privacy tools, such as consent management or privacy management platforms

  • Familiarity with AI governance frameworks and/or emerging AI regulation, including the EU AI Act

  • Experience managing stakeholders and cross-functional teams from project initiation through close

  • Organizational skills with experience managing multiple and sometimes competing priorities

  • Project management, time-management and organizational skills

  • Demonstrated aptitude for problem-solving and delivering operational results

  • Experience operating autonomously across multiple teams and interacting with a diverse range of stakeholders, ranging from front-line engineers to strategic company leadership

  • Comfortable working with colleagues across US and European time zones

  • Healthcare or telehealth experience, CIPP/E, CIPM, or CIPT certification, and working proficiency in French, German, or Spanish are a plus

Our Benefits (there are more but here are some highlights):

  • Competitive salary & equity compensation for full-time roles

  • Unlimited PTO, company holidays, and quarterly mental health days

  • Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental & vision, and parental leave

  • Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)

  • 401k benefits with employer matching contribution

  • Offsite team retreats

We are committed to building a workforce that reflects diverse perspectives and prioritizes ethics, wellness, and a strong sense of belonging. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply—even if you're not sure if your background or experience is a perfect match.
